soundness_flags.label: def:depth and every statement using r_beta(ell)
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed definition quantifies D(c)≠0 without restricting c to the observable image or requiring F_{ell,R}(c) nonempty, so empty off-image fibers make its singleton conclusion false and r_beta is not defined as intended.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 7 (collision-coverage)
soundness_flags.one_line: A source bound |S|≤M does not uniformly bound observed raw moments because graph coefficients are unbounded, and Q_n has no specified computable radius or coefficient envelope.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 7 (collision-coverage)
soundness_flags.one_line: Once C_{≤R}∈Q_n, the true structural parameter itself witnesses beta∈I_n; without a nontrivial size/rate requirement on Q_n, the coverage assertion is only projection of the defining event.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings record; matching accepted arXiv v2, Sections 2.3 and 3.1, Theorems 3.4--3.6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published paper gives k(ell)-cumulant generic identification for the proxy graphs in Theorems 3.4--3.5 and states in Theorem 3.6 that the ell=1 proxy-to-treatment graph is not identifiable from cumulants through order three; its proof uses an unrestricted diagonal-cumulant polynomial parametrization.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 2.2--3.2, especially the stacked cumulant-flattening construction and Theorem 4 cited by the ICML paper
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops cumulant rank matrices and effect-size recovery for latent-confounded linear non-Gaussian models; the 2025 ICML paper accurately cites its Theorem 4 for a degree-(ell+1) bivariate loading polynomial.

The paper gives a single-proxy cross-moment causal-effect method under a non-Gaussian latent confounder and a jointly-Gaussian impossibility result, rather than a finite-depth frontier for the unknown-mechanism proxy graph.
Theorem 3.8 characterizes generic total-effect identifiability with knowledge of the graph through overcomplete-ICA/mixing criteria, not identification from a finite cumulant truncation.
The article supplies an if-and-only-if overcomplete-ICA mixing-identifiability characterization; it does not give a graph-constrained finite truncated-cumulant beta-depth frontier.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and the generic-identifiability propositions cited in Tramontano et al. 2025, Theorem 3.6 proof
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work uses computer algebra to decide identification and generic identifiability for polynomial causal models; it does not construct the proposal's legal real independent-source fiber chambers.

The paper constructs identification- and singularity-robust confidence procedures for general nonlinear moment-condition models, not a simultaneous inversion of the legal proxy-cumulant structural fiber.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair def:depth by quantifying c over im(Phi_{ell,R}) (or its specified legal semialgebraic image), explicitly requiring a nonempty legal fiber, and state whether the generic locus is Zariski-open in the ambient tensor space or relatively Zariski-open in that image.

Replace the collision-coverage tautology with an explicit, sample-computable Q_n: impose a known observed-X envelope or bounded coefficient class, give its radius and a diameter/contraction rate, and state the resulting finite-sample or asymptotic size of I_n near collisions.

Make the correction of Theorem 3.6 auditable by exhibiting a symbolic legal-fiber saturation certificate for ell=1,R=3 and a parameterized finite-support realization of the regular chart; distinguish precisely the unrestricted diagonal-cumulant image used in the published proof from the realizable truncated-moment image.

recommended_next_step: Revise the frontier definition and collision-inference statement, then advance the exact-depth kernel to Stage 0 with the published Theorem 3.6 correction treated as the first mandatory symbolic/legal-fiber audit.
